Wireview component template.description: The root of a component's template: tag_header marks the element the component owns.

Wireview LiveComponent template.description: The root of a LiveComponent's template: its events go to itself with myself=True.

Wireview page layout.description: A page that renders components: the header loads the client.

Wireview component with slots.description: component_block with a filled slot; the rest of the body is the default slot.

Wireview LiveComponent.description: A LiveComponent in its parent's template: the id is required.

Wireview slot with let:.description: A slot that receives what render_slot passes.

Wireview form.description: A form whose submit goes to a handler; its values arrive as the handler's arguments.

Wireview upload.description: A file input and previews for an upload the component allows with allow_upload() in joined().

Wireview stream.description: A stream's container: the template renders it empty, and stream operations insert, move and delete its children.

Wireview hook.description: An element a client hook runs on; wire-update="ignore" keeps what the hook drew.
